# Ocean sky modules

These local ES modules are the WebGL entry points from the original scene's
`@takram/three-geospatial` 0.9.1, `@takram/three-atmosphere` 0.19.1 and
`@takram/three-clouds` 0.7.6 distributions. Only their package import paths and
source-map comments were changed. They reuse this project's `three` and
`postprocessing` packages; no project-wide dependencies are added.

The included Takram license and licenses for code bundled by those distributions
are in `licenses/`. Astronomy Engine's MIT notice is retained in
`atmosphere/shared.js`.
